structured.answer: According to the page, money left in the עו"ש loses value: 10,000 ₪ after 10 years is "worth 8,203 ₪ in today's money", because most banks pay no interest on it. I won't move anything myself. I'll ask my son and the bank why my money earns nothing.

It scared me. Is my money at the bank not safe?
